summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filed by Petrobras, a Brazilian foreign private issuer, announcing the early start-up of the P-79 FPSO platform at the Búzios field. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC transaction, or forced management change is described. The filing is an operational milestone update consistent with the issuer's business plan. Therefore, it does not qualify as a special situation.
